patterns.description: Process of hiring a prehire candidate into a position or job opening
best_practices: Ensure a prehire record exists before initiating the hire process
Verify the staffing model (Job Management vs Position Management) of the Supervisory Organization
Check for hiring restrictions (Job Profile, Location) on the Supervisory Organization before starting
Enter all required compensation data (Salary, Bonus, Merit Plans) during the Propose Compensation step
Upload required worker documents (I-9, etc.) using the Maintain Worker Documents task
anti_patterns: Attempting to hire without a prehire record
Ignoring hiring restrictions on the Supervisory Organization
Assuming Job Management and Position Management processes are identical (Position Management requires an unfilled position)

common_issues.description: Cannot find candidate when initiating hire
common_issues.solution: Create a prehire record for the candidate first.

common_issues.description: Cannot hire into Position Management organization
common_issues.solution: Ensure an unfilled position exists and is available for the hire date.

patterns.description: Managing job postings on internal and external career sites
best_practices: Use 'Update Job Posting' task ONLY for changing start/end dates
To update job description/content: Unpost -> Edit Requisition -> Repost
Do not unpost immediately if multiple openings exist on the requisition
Use 'Primary Posting' option when posting to multiple external sites to control notification links
anti_patterns: Trying to edit job description via 'Update Job Posting' (fields are read-only)
Unposting a multi-opening requisition after the first hire (prevents other candidates from applying)

common_issues.description: Job description fields are grayed out in Update Job Posting
common_issues.solution: Unpost the job, edit the requisition, and repost.

patterns.description: Creating and managing digital and blended learning courses
best_practices: Manually update existing offerings when adding training activities or instructor-led lessons (automatic updates may not occur)
Use 'Update Current Version' when editing a course to maintain version history
Specify allowed assessors for training activity lessons
anti_patterns: Assuming all course edits automatically propagate to existing offerings
Forgetting to publish the course after creation

patterns.description: Creating rules to manage learning content assignment and validation
best_practices: Use learning rules to target specific audiences based on criteria (e.g., location, job profile)
Test rules with a small group of users before applying to a large population
anti_patterns: Creating overly complex rules that are hard to maintain and debug

patterns.description: Grouping multiple courses into a program curriculum
best_practices: Use programs for onboarding or multi-step training paths
Define completion criteria clearly (e.g., all courses required vs. optional)

patterns.description: Creating prospect and candidate records manually
best_practices: Check for duplicates before creating a new candidate record
Use the 'Create Prospect' task for passive candidates who haven't applied yet
Convert prospects to candidates when they apply for a specific job requisition
anti_patterns: Creating a new candidate record for an existing person (creates duplicate data)

patterns.description: Submitting and managing employee referrals
best_practices: Ensure the referrer is correctly linked to the candidate for referral bonus processing
Use the 'Refer a Candidate' task to initiate the process

patterns.description: Adding interactions, captions, and transcriptions to media files
best_practices: Add captions to all video content for accessibility
Use interactions (e.g., quizzes) within video to verify understanding
Use standalone lessons for quick, targeted training distributed via campaigns

patterns.description: Managing candidate progression through the recruiting stages
best_practices: Use 'Move Forward' to advance candidates to the next stage defined in the Job Application BP
Always provide a disposition reason when declining a candidate
Use 'Send Message' to communicate with candidates directly from the candidate grid for audit trails

patterns.description: Managing the lifecycle of contingent workers (contractors)
best_practices: Use 'Contract Contingent Worker' to onboard non-employees
Ensure the 'Contingent Worker Type' is correctly selected for reporting purposes
Use 'End Contingent Worker Contract' to terminate access and close the record
anti_patterns: Treating contingent workers as employees in the system (they use different business processes)

patterns.description: Administering learner enrollments in courses and offerings
best_practices: Use 'Mass Enroll' for assigning mandatory training to large groups
Monitor 'Waitlist' status for popular offerings to manage capacity
Use 'Drop Enrollment' to remove learners who no longer need the training

patterns.description: Managing business process events (Cancel, Rescind, Correct, Delegate)
best_practices: Use 'Rescind' ONLY when the process is successfully COMPLETED (restores state to before process)
Use 'Cancel' when the process is IN PROGRESS (stops the workflow)
Use 'Correct' to fix data entry errors in a process (e.g., wrong start date) without restarting
Use 'Delegate' to temporarily assign tasks (security permissions are based on the delegator)
Use 'Reassign' to permanently transfer ownership of a task (e.g., when a worker leaves)
anti_patterns: Trying to rescind an in-progress event (must cancel)
Trying to cancel a completed event (must rescind)

patterns.description: Updating, freezing, and closing job requisitions
best_practices: Use 'Freeze' to temporarily hold hiring (e.g., budget freeze); candidates can still apply if not unposted
Use 'Close' to permanently end the requisition
Use 'Mass Action on Job Requisitions' report for bulk updates
If editing a posted requisition, remember to unpost and repost if the changes affect the job description
anti_patterns: Attempting to freeze an evergreen requisition (not supported)

patterns.description: How candidates apply for jobs (internal vs external)
best_practices: Internal candidates should apply via the 'Find Jobs' report to link their worker profile
External candidates must create a candidate account on the external career site
Configure 'Quick Apply' to reduce drop-off rates for external candidates
anti_patterns: Internal candidates applying via the external career site (creates duplicate candidate records)

patterns.description: Initiating a job change (transfer, promotion, data change)
best_practices: Select the correct 'Why' (reason) code as it drives downstream logic and reporting
Use 'Start Job Change' from the worker's related actions
Ensure the receiving manager is involved in the process for transfers

patterns.description: Terminating a worker's employment
best_practices: Verify the 'Termination Date' and 'Last Day of Work' (they can be different)
Ensure 'Regrettable' status is accurately captured for retention reporting
Review 'Rescind' vs 'Correct' options if a termination was entered in error
anti_patterns: Terminating a worker who has future-dated processes (cancel them first)

patterns.description: Interacting with report output (filtering, sorting, exporting)
best_practices: Use 'Filter' on column headers to narrow down large datasets
Use 'Export to Excel' for offline analysis but prefer Workday for real-time data
Save frequently used filter sets as 'Saved Filters'

patterns.description: Managing learning completion status, grading, and attendance
best_practices: Manually enter attendance/grades for instructor-led lessons to trigger completion
Use 'Manage Enrollment Completion' to force complete a course if tracking fails (e.g., connectivity issues)
Ensure 'Make Lesson Mandatory' is checked if the lesson is required for course completion
anti_patterns: Attempting to amend results for a course that is already in 'Completed' status (must use 'Retake Course')

patterns.description: Managing course offerings (scheduled instances of a course)
best_practices: Use offerings to schedule specific dates/times for instructor-led courses
Update the offering status to 'Open' to allow enrollments
Use 'Waitlist' configuration to manage demand for popular offerings
anti_patterns: Creating an offering without an instructor (unless it's self-paced)

patterns.description: Navigating the Job Application Business Process (Subprocesses)
best_practices: Understand the linear flow: Review -> Screen -> Assessment -> Interview -> Offer -> Agreement -> Background -> Hire
Use 'Reference Check' and 'Background Check' as parallel subprocesses to save time
Ensure 'Hire' is the final subprocess to transition the candidate to a worker

patterns.description: Scheduling reports to run automatically
best_practices: Schedule long-running reports to run off-hours to avoid performance impact
Use 'Alerts' to notify users only when specific criteria are met (exception reporting)
Share scheduled report output with specific security groups to ensure data privacy
anti_patterns: Scheduling high-frequency reports (e.g., every 5 minutes) without valid business justification

patterns.description: Using global search effectively
best_practices: Use prefixes (e.g., 'bp:', 'rd:', 'task:') to narrow search results
Search for 'people' by name to quickly find worker profiles
Use 'Saved Searches' for complex or frequent queries

patterns.description: Choosing the right report type for the requirement
best_practices: Use 'Advanced Reports' for detailed, tabular data with complex filtering
Use 'Matrix Reports' for summarizing and grouping data (pivot tables)
Use 'Composite Reports' to combine data from multiple sources (e.g., Actuals vs Budget)
Use 'Search Reports' for finding specific records in high-volume data
anti_patterns: Using a 'Simple Report' for complex data needs (limited features)

patterns.description: Responsibilities of a Workday Platform Administrator
best_practices: Manage security groups and business process security policies
Configure and maintain core business process definitions
Support simple integrations (EIBs) and reporting needs
Troubleshoot access and configuration issues

patterns.description: Managing position data and lifecycle in Position Management organizations
best_practices: Use 'Edit Position Restrictions' to update job profile or location for an unfilled position
Close positions that are no longer needed to keep the org chart clean
Ensure the 'Availability Date' is correct for future hires
anti_patterns: Hiring into a position that is 'Frozen' or 'Closed'

patterns.description: Managing the supervisory organization structure
best_practices: Assign a 'Superior Organization' to maintain the hierarchy
Ensure every Supervisory Org has a manager assigned (Role Assignment)
Use 'Move Workers' to transfer employees between organizations during a reorg
anti_patterns: Leaving a Supervisory Organization without a manager (breaks approval workflows)

patterns.description: Configuring the Job Application Business Process
best_practices: Configure 'Review' steps for recruiters to screen candidates
Use 'Assessment' steps to integrate with third-party vendors
Ensure the 'Hire' subprocess is always the final step
Use 'Automatic Decline' rules to filter unqualified candidates early

patterns.description: Navigating Workday using objects and related actions
best_practices: Use the 'Related Actions' (twinkie) icon to access tasks for a specific object
Use 'My Tasks' (Inbox) to approve or review business process steps
Configure 'Shortcuts' in the global navigation menu for frequently used reports

patterns.description: Creating a new requisition by copying an existing one
best_practices: Use 'Copy Details from Existing Job Requisition' to save time on similar roles
Manually review and update 'Target Hire Date' and 'Recruiting Start Date' (these do not copy)
Verify 'Assignable Roles' (e.g., Primary Recruiter) are correct on the new requisition
anti_patterns: Copying a requisition without reviewing 'Replacement For' field (may default incorrectly)

patterns.description: Using analytic indicators in reports to visualize data
best_practices: Use indicators (icons/colors) to highlight status, trends, or exceptions (e.g., Red/Yellow/Green)
Configure indicators to show 'Progress' or 'Rating' visually
Use 'Outlining' to allow users to expand/collapse hierarchical data

patterns.description: Process for contracting a contingent worker using the 'Contract Contingent Worker' business process.
best_practices: Ensure all required HR information is entered accurately.
Review contract details before submission.
anti_patterns: Skipping the review of additional information section.

common_issues.description: Required HR information is missing during the contracting process.
common_issues.solution: Double-check all HR-related fields before submitting the contract.

common_issues.description: The contingent worker's contract is not valid until all required business process steps are complete.
common_issues.solution: Ensure all steps in the business process are completed before considering the contract valid.

patterns.description: Process for converting a contingent worker into an employee using the 'Convert to Employee' task.
best_practices: Ensure the contract end date is before the hire date.
Confirm an unfilled position is available for the hire date.
anti_patterns: Attempting to convert a contingent worker without a valid contract.

common_issues.description: The contract end date is set after the hire date.
common_issues.solution: Adjust the contract end date to ensure it is before the hire date.

common_issues.description: No unfilled position available for the contingent worker on the hire date.
common_issues.solution: Verify that an unfilled position exists before initiating the conversion.

patterns.description: Supervisory organizations serve as the primary organizational structure in Workday HCM, grouping and tracking workers within hierarchical management structures.
best_practices: Define clear hierarchical structures for supervisory organizations.
Utilize the most common organization types provided by Workday to meet business requirements.

patterns.description: Assignable roles manage security permissions and access to workers within supervisory organizations.
best_practices: Regularly review and update assignable roles to ensure they align with organizational changes.
Utilize inherited roles to maintain consistency across subordinate organizations.
anti_patterns: Assign too many roles to a single user, leading to confusion and security risks.
Neglect to update roles when organizational changes occur.

common_issues.description: Inherited roles may not reflect the current responsibilities of subordinate organizations.
common_issues.solution: Regularly audit inherited roles and adjust as necessary to ensure they align with current organizational structure.

patterns.description: Supervisory organizations must have a staffing model that defines how positions are managed and how hiring restrictions are applied.
best_practices: Choose the Position Management model for greater control over staffing.
Use the Job Management model for flexibility and speed in hiring.
anti_patterns: Switch staffing models frequently, causing confusion and disruption in hiring processes.

patterns.description: Organization assignments allow for default memberships in other organization types during staffing changes.
best_practices: Set default organization assignments to streamline the onboarding process for new hires.
Review organization assignments regularly to ensure they are up-to-date.

patterns.description: Member roles and security settings control the visibility of personal data among workers in a supervisory organization.
best_practices: Implement strict access controls to protect sensitive personal data.
Educate members on what data they can access and edit.
anti_patterns: Allow unrestricted access to sensitive data among all members.
Fail to communicate data access policies to workers.

common_issues.description: Members may be confused about what personal data they can view or edit.
common_issues.solution: Provide clear guidelines and training on data access policies to all members.

patterns.description: Utilizing enrollment requirements to enforce business process approvals before learners can start a program.
best_practices: Use the 'Requires Enrollment' checkbox to enforce necessary approvals.
Consider using the 'Skip Enrollment' checkbox for components to streamline the learning experience.

patterns.description: Recognizing previous completions of learning content when creating a program.
best_practices: Specify whether to include all previous completions or those within a defined date range.

patterns.description: Using the My Transcript report to track learner progress and completion status of programs and individual learning content.
best_practices: Regularly review the My Transcript report to monitor learner progress.
Ensure learners understand how to interpret their transcript for accurate tracking.

common_issues.description: Learners may not see completed content if they drop a program without dropping individual content.
common_issues.solution: Educate learners on the importance of dropping all enrolled content to maintain accurate records.

patterns.description: Managing program content by adding existing standalone lessons and courses to create a comprehensive curriculum.
best_practices: Select relevant existing content to ensure the program meets business objectives.
Utilize the 'Exclude from Recommendations' and 'Exclude from Search and Browse' checkboxes to control visibility.

patterns.description: Scheduling reports to run automatically at specified intervals to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
best_practices: Schedule reports to run during off-peak hours to avoid performance issues.
Use dynamic date variables for report criteria to ensure accurate data retrieval.
anti_patterns: Running large reports during peak usage times, which can slow down system performance.
Manually exporting reports instead of using scheduled outputs.

common_issues.description: Scheduled report does not run as expected.
common_issues.solution: Check the schedule settings and ensure the report is not set to skip runs during downtime.

common_issues.description: Scheduled report generates an empty output file.
common_issues.solution: Select the option to not output an empty report to avoid unnecessary files.

patterns.description: Sharing report outputs with other users while managing data access and security.
best_practices: Limit report sharing to only those who need access to maintain data security.
anti_patterns: Sharing reports with users who do not have the appropriate security clearance.

patterns.description: Utilizing the People Analytics dashboard to explore workforce data and gain insights.
best_practices: Regularly review the dashboard for updated insights.
Utilize the refine data button to filter insights for specific dimensions.
anti_patterns: Ignoring the suggested business questions provided by People Analytics.
Failing to interact with visualizations to gain deeper insights.

common_issues.description: Users are unable to access the People Analytics dashboard.
common_issues.solution: Ensure that users have the necessary permissions and roles assigned to access reporting tools.

common_issues.description: Users struggle to interpret the insights provided by the dashboard.
common_issues.solution: Provide training sessions on how to read and analyze the insights effectively.

patterns.description: Analyzing focus insights to understand workforce metrics and trends.
best_practices: Use trend insights to monitor changes over time.
Compare gap insights to identify disparities between different groups.
anti_patterns: Relying solely on historical data without considering current trends.
Neglecting to explore the top drivers impacting metrics.

common_issues.description: Focus insights are not clear or actionable.
common_issues.solution: Encourage users to utilize help text and business questions for better context.

patterns.description: Using KPIs to summarize the overall health and performance of the organization.
best_practices: Regularly review KPIs to track organizational performance.
Use KPIs to guide strategic decision-making.
anti_patterns: Ignoring KPI trends and focusing only on static data.
Failing to align KPIs with business goals.

common_issues.description: KPIs do not align with current business objectives.
common_issues.solution: Regularly update KPIs to reflect changing business goals and priorities.

patterns.description: Developing actionable business goals based on insights from People Analytics.
best_practices: Create business goals that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound (SMART).
Involve leadership in the goal-setting process to ensure alignment.
anti_patterns: Setting vague or unrealistic goals based on insights.
Failing to communicate goals to relevant stakeholders.

common_issues.description: Challenges in implementing the developed business goals.
common_issues.solution: Establish clear action plans and assign responsibilities for goal achievement.

patterns.description: The process of creating a job requisition in Workday Recruiting, including the necessary fields and steps.
best_practices: Use the guided editor for entering job requisition details.
Ensure all required fields are filled out before submission.
Review defaulted information from job profiles and positions.
anti_patterns: Skipping the review of defaulted fields can lead to incorrect job requisition details.
Not unposting and reposting jobs after modifications can cause discrepancies on career sites.

common_issues.description: Job requisition submission fails due to missing required fields.
common_issues.solution: Ensure all mandatory fields are filled out in the guided editor before submitting.

common_issues.description: Job postings do not reflect recent changes made to the job requisition.
common_issues.solution: Unpost and repost the job to ensure career sites are updated with the latest information.

patterns.description: The method of copying existing job requisitions to create new ones, including necessary manual entries.
best_practices: Review all details carefully when copying from an existing job requisition.
Manually enter any fields that do not auto-populate during the copy process.
anti_patterns: Failing to check the accuracy of copied details can lead to errors in the new job requisition.
Not updating manually entered fields can result in outdated or incorrect information.

common_issues.description: New job requisition created from a copy is missing critical information.
common_issues.solution: Always verify and complete all required fields after copying a job requisition.

patterns.description: The change job business process controls job changes between hire and termination events, including promotions, transfers, and location changes.
best_practices: Utilize templates to streamline the change job process for different user roles.
Ensure all required data is entered before submitting a job change.
anti_patterns: Skipping required fields in the job change process.
Not configuring templates based on user roles, leading to confusion.

common_issues.description: Job change submission fails due to missing required data.
common_issues.solution: Ensure all required fields are filled out before submission.

common_issues.description: Incorrect fields display due to misconfigured job change templates.
common_issues.solution: Review and adjust the job change templates for each security group.

patterns.description: Microtasks provide simplified pages with only the necessary fields for specific job changes.
best_practices: Use microtasks for specific job changes to reduce complexity for users.
Limit access to microtasks based on user roles to maintain security.
anti_patterns: Allowing all users access to all microtasks, leading to potential security issues.
Overcomplicating microtasks with unnecessary fields.

common_issues.description: Users unable to access necessary microtasks for job changes.
common_issues.solution: Check and adjust security group permissions to ensure appropriate access.

patterns.description: The guided editor assists users in completing each section of the job change process.
best_practices: Leverage the guided editor to ensure users complete job changes accurately.
Train users on how to effectively use the guided editor.
anti_patterns: Ignoring the guided editor prompts, leading to incomplete submissions.
Not providing training on the guided editor, resulting in user confusion.

common_issues.description: Users struggle to navigate the guided editor, leading to errors.
common_issues.solution: Provide additional training and resources on using the guided editor.

patterns.description: The process for internal candidates to apply for job postings within the organization.
best_practices: Ensure internal candidates can easily access job postings.
Provide clear instructions for applying and monitoring application status.

common_issues.description: Internal candidates cannot see the apply button after submitting an application.
common_issues.solution: Communicate to candidates that they can only apply once and provide a way to view their application status.

patterns.description: The process for external candidates to apply for job postings through various channels.
best_practices: Offer multiple application methods (manual entry, resume upload, LinkedIn integration).
Ensure the application form is user-friendly and guides candidates through the process.

common_issues.description: External candidates may find the application form too complex or lengthy.
common_issues.solution: Simplify the application form and provide clear instructions for each section.

patterns.description: A feature that allows candidates to store their information for future applications.
best_practices: Encourage candidates to create a candidate home account for easier future applications.
Preload information from previous applications to streamline the process.

common_issues.description: Information from previous applications may not preload correctly.
common_issues.solution: Regularly test the candidate home account functionality to ensure data is accurately preloaded.

patterns.description: Utilization of the candidate skills cloud feature to assess and score applications based on skills.
best_practices: Enable the candidate skills cloud feature to enhance recruitment efficiency.
Use skill scoring to match candidates with job requisitions effectively.

common_issues.description: Candidate skills may not be accurately assessed or aligned with job requisitions.
common_issues.solution: Regularly review and update the skill assessment criteria to ensure relevance.

patterns.description: The process of managing prospects and converting them into active candidates within Workday Recruiting.
best_practices: Differentiate between active candidates and prospects to tailor outreach strategies.
Utilize mobile devices to quickly create prospect records during events.
Use the 'Find Candidates' report to filter and view prospects effectively.
anti_patterns: Failing to nurture prospects before they are ready to apply.
Not checking for duplicate records when creating new prospects.

common_issues.description: Recruiters may not have access to Workday Recruiting on mobile devices during events.
common_issues.solution: Ensure that all recruiters have Workday Recruiting enabled on their mobile devices for immediate data entry.

common_issues.description: Duplicate prospect records may be created if checks are not performed.
common_issues.solution: Always check for duplicates before creating a new prospect record.

patterns.description: The distinction and management of internal and external prospects within the recruiting process.
best_practices: Create prospect records for internal workers showing interest in open positions.
Utilize the 'Prospect Introduce Yourself' feature on external career sites to gather potential candidates.
anti_patterns: Ignoring internal candidates by not creating prospect records for them.
Failing to utilize external career site features to capture potential prospects.

common_issues.description: Internal workers interested in roles may not be added as prospects.
common_issues.solution: Use the 'Create from Existing Workers' option to ensure internal candidates are captured as prospects.

common_issues.description: External candidates may not submit their information effectively.
common_issues.solution: Promote the 'Prospect Introduce Yourself' feature on career sites to encourage submissions.

patterns.description: The process of converting prospects to active candidates through application submissions.
best_practices: Link prospects to job requisitions to convert them into active candidates.
Utilize the 'Invite to Apply' feature to encourage prospects to complete their applications.
anti_patterns: Not converting prospects to active candidates when they apply directly for a job.
Overlooking the importance of nurturing prospects before inviting them to apply.

common_issues.description: Prospects may not be converted to active candidates if not linked to a job requisition.
common_issues.solution: Ensure that all prospects are linked to relevant job requisitions to facilitate their conversion.

common_issues.description: Candidates applying without being a prospect may not have a record in Workday.
common_issues.solution: Encourage recruiters to create prospect records for candidates before they apply.

patterns.description: Copying existing offerings to streamline the creation of multiple offerings for a course.
best_practices: Ensure appropriate security configurations are enabled on the Manage Course Offering business process security policy.

patterns.description: Updating course offering details directly at the offering level for flexibility.
best_practices: Update offering details as requirements change, including location, dates, times, and instructors.

patterns.description: Creating a new course version when editing course details to maintain historical accuracy.
best_practices: Advance the version number and provide an explanation of changes when creating a new course version.
Use the Update Offerings to Version task for future-dated offerings.

common_issues.description: The Update Offerings to Version task does not update instructor-led or training activity course lessons.
common_issues.solution: Manually apply updates to each applicable offering.

patterns.description: Canceling course offerings before their scheduled date for various reasons.
best_practices: Configure notifications on the Cancel Course Offering business process to inform learners about cancellations.

common_issues.description: Canceling an offering does not remove it from the learner's transcript.
common_issues.solution: Learners must manually drop the canceled offering to remove it from their transcript.

patterns.description: Enabling and managing waitlists for course offerings to control enrollment.
best_practices: Enable autoenrollment for waitlists to automate the enrollment process.
Use the Manage Waitlists report to monitor and manage waitlists effectively.

patterns.description: Workday reports offer unique interaction capabilities such as column manipulation, drill down, and filtering to enhance data analysis.
best_practices: Utilize column preferences to customize report views.
Leverage drill down features to explore data in depth.
Use facet filtering to narrow down report results effectively.

patterns.description: Data drilling techniques allow users to view detailed data and additional dimensions from summary reports.
best_practices: Encourage users to explore data through drill down options for deeper insights.
Provide training on how to use drill to report links for efficient navigation.

patterns.description: Charts in Workday reports allow dynamic interaction, enabling users to hover for details and select values for further drilling.
best_practices: Encourage the use of interactive charts for better data visualization.
Train users to configure charts to suit their analysis needs.

patterns.description: Workday allows users to export report outputs to Excel or PDF for sharing and further analysis.
best_practices: Regularly export reports for offline analysis and sharing.
Ensure users know how to access exported reports from their profile menu.

patterns.description: A structured process for employees to refer candidates, including steps for creating referrals and managing them.
best_practices: Include help text for fields in the referral process to guide users.
Implement a review step in the referral process to alert recruiters of new referrals.

common_issues.description: Some organizations do not have a review step in the referral process.
common_issues.solution: Consider implementing a review step to ensure recruiters are notified of new referrals.

patterns.description: Utilizing notifications to inform recruiters and candidates about referrals and job applications.
best_practices: Use notifications to alert recruiters of new referrals.
Send notifications to invite referrals to apply for jobs.

patterns.description: Reports designed to help manage and track referral candidates effectively.
best_practices: Utilize the My Referrals report to track referred candidates.
Leverage the Referrals Without Job Applications report to identify candidates who need to apply.

patterns.description: Allowing employees to share job postings via social media to increase candidate referrals.
best_practices: Enable social media sharing options for job postings to broaden the reach of referrals.

patterns.description: The job application business process serves as a customizable framework for managing candidates through various recruiting stages.
best_practices: Customize the job application process to fit organizational needs.
Utilize parallel stages to improve recruiter efficiency.

patterns.description: Automatic stage routing allows candidates to be moved through the recruiting process based on specific criteria.
best_practices: Set up condition rules for automatic stage routing to ensure qualified candidates are moved forward.
Consider implementing a delay before sending decline notifications to candidates.

patterns.description: Disposition reasons are specific to each recruiting subprocess, ensuring relevant options are available for declining candidates.
best_practices: Ensure disposition reasons are contextually relevant to the current stage of the recruiting process.
anti_patterns: Allowing irrelevant disposition reasons to be selected at inappropriate stages.

patterns.description: The automatic decline feature helps manage candidates by automatically declining those not hired when a job requisition is closed.
best_practices: Use automatic decline to keep candidates informed and reduce manual workload.

patterns.description: Security policies are segmented based on the candidate's recruiting stage, ensuring that only authorized users can access sensitive information.
best_practices: Implement segmented security to protect candidate information based on their application stage.

patterns.description: Managing hiring restrictions for supervisory organizations based on the staffing model.
best_practices: Always review the staffing model type before managing hiring restrictions.
Use the appropriate business process for changing job data.
anti_patterns: Editing worker data for unfilled positions.

common_issues.description: Attempting to edit worker data for unfilled positions.
common_issues.solution: Ensure that only filled positions have their worker data edited.

patterns.description: Managing temporary assignments using different business processes.
best_practices: Use the Change Job business process for temporary assignments with a defined end date.
Utilize the Add Job task for more flexible temporary assignments.

common_issues.description: Not defining an end date for temporary assignments.
common_issues.solution: Use the Add Job task for assignments without a clear end date.

patterns.description: Closing positions or initiating hiring freezes for supervisory organizations.
best_practices: Only close unfilled positions to prevent errors.
Use the manage position freeze task to apply hiring freezes effectively.
anti_patterns: Closing filled positions.

common_issues.description: Closing a position in error.
common_issues.solution: Use the resend closed position business process to rectify the mistake.

patterns.description: Various methods to access reports in Workday, including global search, custom report running, and profile menu options.
best_practices: Utilize search prefixes for efficient report retrieval.
Tag reports for easier categorization and access.

common_issues.description: Users may not see certain reports due to lack of permissions.

anti_patterns: Unposting a job immediately after hiring the first candidate.
Failing to update job descriptions before reposting.

common_issues.description: Unable to update job description directly through the update job posting task.
common_issues.solution: Unpost the job, make necessary changes to the requisition, and then repost the job.

common_issues.description: Job postings may not automatically unpost as expected based on the remaining openings.
common_issues.solution: Ensure that the automatic unpost job step is configured correctly in the system settings.

patterns.description: Utilizing the job postings tab as a timeline to manage current, future, and past job postings.
best_practices: Regularly review the job postings tab to keep track of all job postings.
Use the timeline view to manage job postings effectively.

patterns.description: Using filters to refine report data for analysis.
best_practices: Apply relevant filters to focus on specific data.
Regularly review and update filters to ensure data relevance.
anti_patterns: Using overly broad filters that include irrelevant data.
Neglecting to update filters as business needs change.

common_issues.description: Reports include irrelevant data due to improper filtering.
common_issues.solution: Review and adjust filters to ensure only relevant data is displayed.

patterns.description: Sorting report data to enhance readability and analysis.
best_practices: Sort data logically to facilitate easier analysis.
Override default sorting when necessary to meet specific reporting needs.
anti_patterns: Relying solely on default sorting without considering user needs.
Sorting data in a way that confuses report users.

common_issues.description: Data is sorted in a confusing manner, making analysis difficult.
common_issues.solution: Reconfigure sorting options to align with user expectations.

patterns.description: Utilizing prompts to gather user input for report generation.
best_practices: Clearly indicate required prompts to avoid user confusion.
Allow users to save prompt values for future use.
anti_patterns: Overloading reports with too many prompts, leading to user frustration.
Failing to provide clear instructions for prompt completion.

common_issues.description: Users fail to provide necessary prompt values, resulting in incomplete reports.
common_issues.solution: Ensure prompts are clearly marked and provide guidance on required inputs.

patterns.description: Grouping data in reports to summarize and analyze information effectively.
best_practices: Use grouping to summarize data for better insights.
Ensure that groupings are logical and relevant to the report's purpose.
anti_patterns: Creating overly complex groupings that confuse users.
Neglecting to provide subtotals or grand totals when necessary.

common_issues.description: Data appears to be missing due to aggregation in the 'other' category.
common_issues.solution: Check for the 'other' row or column in matrix reports to find aggregated data.

patterns.description: Incorporating analytic indicators to visually represent data trends and statuses.
best_practices: Use analytic indicators to enhance data interpretation.
Ensure indicators are relevant and clearly defined for users.
anti_patterns: Overusing indicators, leading to visual clutter.
Using unclear or ambiguous indicators that confuse users.

common_issues.description: Users find it difficult to interpret the meaning of analytic indicators.
common_issues.solution: Provide clear definitions and training on the use of analytic indicators.

common_issues.description: User cannot initiate business process due to security policy
symptoms: Error message 'You do not have permission to...'
common_issues.solution: Check Security Policy for the Business Process (e.g., 'Hire' BP Policy) and ensure user's security group is allowed to initiate.
prevention: Test business processes with proxy as end user
